name: canonical-composite-flow-runner-ready
description: The canonical sixteen-step composite flow with a Runner-ready outcome: runner setup reaches ready and the one setup approval configures the AI Chief of Staff on the Runner LANE it preferred. That is a statement about the lane, not about the chief of staff being active on it — activation is decided from the rehearsal evidence for the lane it actually reached, so a run reports the activation state it observes and never promises runner-active-at-setup. The owner also takes the optional launch for the agents the plan left in draft.
